acceptance.authoritativePolicy: Submit fails closed when the trusted attempt-policy resolver is unavailable or returns no policy. A valid policy permits a bounded later attempt or denies it before any terminal mutation.
acceptance.atomicNumbering: The repository allocates the next positive attempt number inside the same aggregate CAS transaction that appends the immutable attempt, result, completion, index, and operation receipt.
acceptance.priorRowPreservation: A second distinct valid operation creates attempt 2 while retaining attempt 1 and its result, completion, and index unchanged.
acceptance.idempotency: Exact replay of attempt 2 returns the original receipt and attempt number. Conflicting idempotency-key reuse remains fail-closed.
acceptance.attemptLimit: A third distinct operation under maxAttempts 2 is denied without adding or replacing any terminal row.
acceptance.malformedSequence: Missing, duplicate, or non-positive persisted attempt numbers fail closed instead of silently renumbering legacy or corrupt rows.
acceptance.aggregateIntegrity: Before allocating a later attempt, the repository validates contiguous numbering and exact attempt/result/completion/index identity, version, draft revision, provenance, operation, and timestamp agreement; gaps, orphans, mismatches, and incomplete replays fail closed.
acceptance.durableReplayRetention: The bounded operation map preserves accepted and denied terminal receipts, prunes only older non-terminal receipts, rejects terminal-capacity exhaustion, and rejects any deterministic attempt/result/completion/index ID collision before mutation.
acceptance.immutableVersionPins: Every terminal row persists the canonical activityVersionId, acknowledged draft revision, Page Group keys, Source Version IDs, and local pages from the authorized Delivery binding.
acceptance.deniedIdempotency: Attempt-limit denial is persisted through the same scoped CAS aggregate. Exact replay remains denied even if policy later changes, while conflicting reuse of the key fails closed.
acceptance.browser: The previously recorded authenticated Student localhost:5174 terminal-submit proof remains applicable. This backend aggregate repair adds no route or UI and makes no new repeated-attempt product-journey claim.
acceptance.deployment: Not claimed. Deployed/canary terminal proof, active identity/config/generated-rules readback, cleanup, telemetry, and operational rollback remain owned by #134.
acceptance.rollback: Canonical production composition still has no attempt-policy resolver and therefore fails terminal submit closed. Worker routes and every trusted capability remain disabled.
